fields.description:
Background Job: the reply is produced by a background worker, so long replies are not cut off by the web server's time limit and chat does not hold a web worker. If no worker is running, chat falls back to In Request automatically.
In Request: the reply is produced inside the web request, as before. On a production server, replies longer than the request time limit (default 2 minutes) are cut off.
fields.label: Run Chat Replies
